deliberateDepartures.detail: The explicit common six-role light palette replaces the warm sample and scheme palette. Declared Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif replaces sample Latin handwritten fonts. Text remains upright.

Geometry, label sizes, and connector routes follow each target aspect ratio, rather than scaling the 720×400 reference page. The supplied pilot-3 scheme takes precedence over sparse/removable texture advice: each diagram retains an exposed distributed crossed-pencil field with seeded position jitter (1307), 12.5-unit diagonal intervals, and opposing intersecting families.
Crossed fields occupy surrounding backing planes; vacant chair seats and the empty return box interior remain untextured. Compact labels are 14–15 CSS px; essential labels elsewhere are 16–22 CSS px.
